{{Quote|By all the gods, look at that! We blew that ship out of the air!"<br />"''That'' was storage tank sixteen, you idiot.|Nomo and Zyak|<ref name="Dark Forces: Rebel Agent">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>}}
'''Storage tank sixteen''' was a [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] storage tank located in [[Fuel City]], which was located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]], near fueling [[Fuel City|station six]]. While [[Mission to Sulon|battling]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial troops]], [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Jan Ors]] destroyed storage tank sixteen, prompting air-traffic controllers [[Zyak]] and [[Nomo]] to try and shut off the fuel valves for the rest of the tanks, in order to minimize the risk of them exploding from a fuel leakage. However, before they could act, Ors destroyed tanks [[Storage tank fifteen|fifteen]], [[Storage tank fourteen|fourteen]], and [[Storage tank thirteen|thirteen]]. Zyak deserted his post as a result, leaving the inexperienced Nomo in charge.
